}

{
text = The nearest target is a road blockade on the highway directly between our airbase and the coast.///n///nYour task here is to destroy the fortified bunkers and armored units.///n///nThe blockade position is marked by the objective waypoint.

audioClipPath =
}

{
text = A single MAD-4 missile site is known to be covering the area by the coast.///n///nWe recommend suppressing this threat before moving to the next set of coastal targets.

audioClipPath =
}

{

imagePath = t55\coastalDefense\river.png
audioClipPath =
}
BRIEFING_NOTE
{

}

{

}
